knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/296/diabetes+130-us+hospitals+for+years+1999-2008

```{r}
# Load required packages
library(arules)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)

# Step 1: Load data
diabetic_data <- read_csv("diabetic_data.csv")
ids_mapping <- read_csv("IDS_mapping.csv")
```

```{r}
# Check structure and sample of IDS_mapping
glimpse(ids_mapping)
head(ids_mapping)
colnames(ids_mapping)

```
```{r}
colnames(ids_mapping) <- trimws(colnames(ids_mapping))

```

```{r}
# Step 2: Apply mapping from IDS_mapping to diabetic_data
# Convert ids_mapping into a list of lookup tables by variable
mapping_list <- split(ids_mapping, ids_mapping$variable)
```

```{r}
# Replace coded columns with descriptions
for (var in names(mapping_list)) {
  map_df <- mapping_list[[var]]
  if (var %in% colnames(diabetic_data)) {
    code_to_desc <- setNames(map_df$description, map_df$code)
    diabetic_data[[var]] <- as.character(diabetic_data[[var]])
    diabetic_data[[var]] <- code_to_desc[diabetic_data[[var]]]
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Step 3: Select relevant categorical variables for transaction analysis
# Feel free to add/remove variables
vars_for_arules <- c("age", "gender", "race", "readmitted",
                     "admission_type_id", "discharge_disposition_id",
                     "admission_source_id", 
                     "metformin", "glipizide", "insulin", "glyburide")

# Subset the data and convert to factor
trans_data <- diabetic_data %>%
  select(all_of(vars_for_arules)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.factor(.)))
```

```{r}
# Step 4: Convert data to "transactions" format
trans <- as(trans_data, "transactions")
```

```{r}
# Optional: inspect a few transactions
inspect(trans[1:5])
```

```{r}
# Step 5: Run the Apriori algorithm
rules <- apriori(trans, parameter = list(support = 0.05, confidence = 0.6))
```

```{r}
# Step 6: View results
summary(rules)
inspect(head(rules, n = 10, by = "lift"))
```

```{r}
# Optional: Plot top rules (need arulesViz)
# install.packages("arulesViz") if not already installed
library(arulesViz)
plot(rules, method = "graph", engine = "htmlwidget")


```

```{r}
library(htmlwidgets)
saveWidget(plot(rules, method = "graph", engine = "htmlwidget"), "apriori_plot.html")


```
